review:
Wonderland, but make it surreal modern art. Alice WonderLuck runs on 50 lines and borrows favourite features from several other BGaming games, with mystery drops and a few risk-or-reward choices thrown in.

The fun part is that the free spins change from round to round, so two bonuses rarely play the same way. Mystery SpinUP raises your stake and drops mystery symbols on every spin if you want more action. It's rated very high volatility with a 10,000x max, and the 97% RTP is excellent – but free spins average about once every 318 spins, so be ready for long stretches of base game.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
